## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Chore / build / CI

## Testing

How did you verify this change? Manual repro steps, services exercised,
edge cases considered.

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff format .` is clean
- [ ] `ruff check .` is clean
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (if user-visible)
- [ ] Related issue linked (or explanation if none)
- [ ] No new secrets, hardcoded paths, or internal hostnames introduced
